reviews.comment: MKTG 443- not a good professor. do not take if you are a bims major looking for easy directed elective. tests require you to pay attention every day in class and take very detailed notes for incredibly specific questions. not worth it
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Seipp's "Marketing Consulting" course was disappointing. Most of the class involved guest speakers who didn't work in consulting and busywork on frameworks with no practical application. Instead of learning about different consulting paths, we had a speaker tell us we'd never make it into the Big 4, which was discouraging and unhelpful.

Mrs. Seipp's grad level consulting course wasn't great. She made it easy, but she really wasn't teaching us anything. I did enjoy the guest speakers, but didn't understand why we were not given the list of speakers when we were given the syllabus. The class felt monotonous and could have been an asynchronous course/online.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I love professor Seipp! She is genuinely so passionate and cares about her students. I had her for both MKTG 322 and 323, and I believe she restructured her courses this semester. There is a group project which she gives you so much time in class to do. She makes her lectures very interactive which makes it much easier to learn.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Amazing lectures --Caring

reviews.comment: I dont think professor Seipp actually taught me anything throughout the whole class. She doesnt explain things, just plays videos in class or has you watch videos outside of class. So unhelpful when trying to clarify assignment/grading expectations. Do not take her

Prof. Seipp is not an effective lecturer. This was an online class, and the lectures consisted of the professor reading her notes in a monotone voice with a limited explanation of key terms. I was amazed by the lack of effort that went into creating this course.

online class and all she posts is video lectures that are boring. She goes way too fast over the material and it sounds like shes reading straight out of the textbook. The only grades you have are 4exams and 1research credit. SHE DOES NOT CURVE TESTS OR OFFER EXTRA CREDIT. I read all chapters required for the tests and still failed. Worst prof.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: To say this course was horrendous was an understatement. Professors first test alone kept asking questions about stuff not even remotely based on marketing. No matter how much studying you do, you will more than likely never get an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Her MKTG409 changed-her goal is to have a class GPA b/t a 2.3 & 3 (syllabus). The new book we use has wrong answers to practice MCQ probs, and yes of course she pulls from these same questions w/o informing us that some answers are wrong. 460/500 points for the class from tests. Her lectures are READING VERBATIM THE BOOK. Minimal effort on her end.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Took the online class. All you have is exams and the research credits. Exams are very detailed verbatim over the lectures, which is basically her reading the textbook. Kinda boring, but at least the videos are short. Must watch everything she tells you to, there are very detailed questions on the exam. Not hard to make an A if you watch videos.

reviews.comment: Seipp is a super chill professor. She is so nice and also understanding of her student's various needs and schedules. She really takes the time to break things down. The content of her lectures is very digestible. Some of her test questions are really random but other than that her class is great.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Man this was a hard class... for every test, there were questions over the lectures, speakers, group projects, the novel she made you read, articles she assigns, and 2 hour documentaries you have to watch. I learned a lot from this class, but the exams are so obscure it made me hate what I was learning . Could have been taught so much better.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: love her lectures, they are fun and enjoyable! First college exam I've ever gotten a C in was in her class though (and I am a graduating senior)
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS OR PROFESSOR! Tests are extremely specific and difficult. Final paper at the end of class is graded extremely harshly. Professor sadly does not seem to understand how to teach, and does not seem to care at all about students.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: At first, I truly enjoyed this class, until the halfway point. She became extremely disorganized & kept adding things that were NOT on the instructions to the research paper. When we were obviously confused about the paper & proceeded to ask multiple questions she said: "you guys just make me want to leave class right now". SO unprofessional.
reviews.ratingTags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I am really unsure of how to rate Professor Seipp because I love her dearly as a person, but her class is EXTREMELY time consuming. It seriously takes up all of my time and leaves me little time for other classes. She makes you read books for each exam while simultaneously working on a SOLO semester long (25+ page) research paper. Tests are hard
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: I loved professor Seipp! The class is super interesting and I loved the books she had us read. However, this class is not a walk in the park. You have to read the books, you have to attend lectures because she tests on what is said in class, and you have to put in the time and effort. The project is a ton of work so start early and ask for help.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: do not take seipp if you're trying to get an A in this class. she is so disorganized & unclear of every assignment and test. there are 3 tests, individual research paper that is worth 30% of your grade, and a project. she doesn't explain everything and class is just copying lecture notes. not a good teacher at all.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: 3 tests that are unnecessarily hard, makes you read literal books for the tests, semester long research paper that is so much work and so in depth. She gave us a rubric less than 2 weeks from the due date and every class period would add something new to what she wanted on the paper. Literally updated syllabus every week because so disorganized

reviews.comment: Really hard exams. The assignments are so simple and easy to get done but have nothing to do with exams. You have to read the entire book, six chapters per exam to be exact, for an exam that is so detailed you would have difficulty answering it if you had the book in front of you.
reviews.ratingTags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Leslie is an awesome prof for CSR! You read 4 books during the class with quizzes after each of them. They are usually insightful, and as long as you do a light read of the whole book, you should do well on them. You have to go to class to do well on tests. The tests are m/c with short answers and 2 essays. As long as you study notes, you're good.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: While the assignments for this class are easy, the tests are way too hard. You must read the entire textbook, and the test questions are so specific that even with open book and open note, the highest grade I made was an 85. The powerpoints are quotes from the text verbatim. You must read, and it is content heavy. I would not take it online again.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: ONLINE CLASS IS HARD, tests are very hard

Easy A. Only time I ever did anything for this class was for the exams. It's common sense material if you've listened to everything Schmidt from New Girl says about marketing - serious, its that easy. If you don't get an A in this class, it's because you either 1) missed an exam or 2) forgot you're taking the class completely. Lots of extra credit.

reviews.comment: quizzes and tests are all timed. you will not have enough time unless you have memorized the slides and read the chapters thoroughly. questions are confusing and do not tie into her lecture slides well. would not recommend this professor if you can avoid her.
